review.note: The independent reviewer could inspect the exact diff but its sandbox could not execute Node due Windows filesystem permissions; the listed tests were executed successfully by the controlling process.

limitations: Google provider activation and a real remote account round trip were not performed in this local certification.
Final GitHub jobs remain responsible for candidate-wide recertification.
notes: OAuth uses Supabase Auth with PKCE S256 and resolves exactly one active Qüata profile; it does not create or guess profiles.
Android persists pending state encrypted, binds callbacks to an opaque attempt token, and separates recovered sign-in navigation from identity linking.
Web reserves the popup within the user gesture, survives COOP detachment through BroadcastChannel, exposes explicit cancellation, and prevents stale session publication.
No credentials were copied and no backend rows, provider settings, CI configuration or remote product data were mutated.
